end.parentNote: Myra practised copying shapes by counting horizontal and vertical units on a grid. They used the direction method—across first, then down—and correctly explained that the spaces between dots are counted, not the dots themselves. They first mixed up dots and gaps, then corrected this during the lesson. At home, practise drawing a short line between dots and counting the gaps aloud.
